name: ReservationDataList
description: ReservationDataList schema from Quandoo Public Partner API

id.description: The agent-dependent unique id of the reservation.

number.description: The id of the reservation on quandoo system.

reservationNumber.description: The long id of this reservation on quandoo system.

quandooId.description: The public id of this reservation on quandoo system.

updatedAt.description: The date the review created on. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

customerId.description: The public ID of the customer to which this reservation belongs.

promocode.description: The promotion code used in this reservation. Optional.

extraInfo.description: Extra information that the customer provided for the reservation. Optional.

links.description: The links related to this entity.

reservationTags.description: A list of reservation tag IDs.
